title: Lead sync pocket journal — Ops / API / Console priorities
content:
Morning pocket notes for prep with Eng lead (quick, scannable). Goal: align on immediate operational risks, unblock decisions that need PM sponsorship, and agree on owner + ETA for follow-ups. Keep this lean — I will bring printed copy to the meeting.

Context snapshot:
- Hosted API 99th p95 latency dipped after last rollout; preliminary traces point to model variant fallback loop in 2 edge regions.
- Dedicated onboarding queue: 3 customers pending capacity assignment; infra quota exhaustion on NVME nodes + autoscale policy not triggering as expected.
- Console rollout: rollout #13 for per-route quotas has UI layout regression in Safari — low severity but customer-visible.

Meeting agenda (20–25 mins):
1) Quick sync (3m): what changed since last sync (incidents, customer escalations).
2) Latency investigation status (7m): ask for root-cause hypothesis, rollout rollback plan, and gating criteria to re-open full traffic.
3) Dedicated capacity assignment (6m): confirm short-term manual fixes vs longer autoscale policy changes; discuss communication to affected customers.
4) Console/SRE coordination (4m): decide whether to ship a small UI patch or ship with release note mitigation.
5) Actions & owners (3m): confirm commitments, dates.

My prep notes / prompts to use during sync (phrased as quick questions):
- Latency traces: do we have a single repro route or a broad distribution? If single route, can we quarantine it by routing policy while fix is staged?
- Fallback loop: which compatibility check fails and causes repeated fallback? Is it a model config mismatch or a kernel selection bug?
- KV cache hit-rate delta that coincided with spike — did we auto-evict or invalidate? Any rolling restart that could have purged warm caches?
- Dedicated nodes: what exact metric prevented autoscale (NVME utilization, GPU allocation, scheduler backpressure)? Would a short-term burst pool be safe to open?
- Console regression: is it purely layout/CSS or a build-time bundling issue? If we ship a CSS patch, can we phase it behind a feature flag?

Open issues I want decisions on this meeting:
- Approve immediate routing quarantine for 5% of traffic away from suspect route (prod policy entailed) — decision needed: yes/no + who triggers.
- Approve emergency manual capacity bump on Dedicated (cost estimate ~ $4k/week) until autoscale fix — need PO signoff.
- Decide on opt-in telemetry to record fallback chain details for next 30 days to help root-cause — privacy ok but confirm retention.

Quick status matrix (one-liners to read out):
- Latency: triage ongoing; tentative rollback candidate identified (model variant v2.4 -> v2.3). Owner: Asha. ETA: 2026-03-13 EOD for rollback decision.
- Dedicated capacity: manual allocation script ready; requires infra SRE approval and billing confirmation. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-03-14 morning.
- Console: small CSS fix branch open; QA flakiness on Safari only. Owner: frontend team (Sam). ETA: 2026-03-15 unless we ship mitigation notes.
- Observability: need finer fallback-chain traces; will increase sampling from 0.5% to 5% for 72 hours. Owner: infra-observability. ETA: 2026-03-12 rolling deploy.

Follow-ups I will propose and record during meeting (format: what / who / due):
- "Quarantine suspect route" / Eng lead (Asha) / 2026-03-12 14:00 PT.
- "Manual capacity assignment for three pending customers" / Priya / 2026-03-14 10:00 PT.
- "Telemetry increase for fallback chain" / Infra-obs (Li) / 2026-03-12 18:00 PT.
- "Customer comms draft for capacity bump" / PM comms (me) / 2026-03-13 09:00 PT.
- "Patch decision for console layout" / Frontend lead (Sam) / 2026-03-15 EOD.

Escalation ladder (if owners miss ETA):
- First ping: PM -> owner (same day).
- Second: PM -> Eng lead + SRE manager (24hrs after missed ETA).
- Third: Exec notify (VP eng + Head of Product) if >72hrs and severe customer impact.

Notes to self (things to capture in follow-up email):
- Include minimal packet: incident timeline, initial mitigation steps, rollback plan, customer list impacted, cost delta if any.
- Ask legal about telemetry retention if we raise sampling for fallback chains.
- Schedule 30-minute deep-dive next week with infra+serving runtime to parse kernel selection telemetry.

Quick risks / mitigations (for rapid read):
- Risk: Quarantine will increase latency for quarantined customers if routed to a higher-cost region. Mitigation: only apply quarantine at 5% incremental traffic and monitor SLA.
- Risk: Manual capacity bump triggers billing approval delay. Mitigation: pre-clear budget holder and CC finance in change request.
- Risk: Telemetry increase might surface PII traces in logs. Mitigation: run retention and redaction check with Legal before rolling to 5%.

One-line ask I will open the meeting with: "I need alignment on three immediate operational decisions — routing quarantine, temporary capacity bump, and telemetry ramp — so we can stabilize customer experience before EOD Monday."

End-of-meeting template (to send as follow-up email):
- TL;DR of decisions made.
- Owners + due dates (table-like bullets).
- Any blockers and escalation steps.
- Links to artifacts and logs.

Mental checklist before meeting:
- Bring traces export (last 2 hours).
- Confirm SRE on standby for quarantine.
- Have cost estimate for manual bump.
- Draft customer note skeleton.

----
Copy of quick snippets to paste into Slack after meeting: 
- "We agreed to quarantine route X at 5% to mitigate fallback loop; Asha to action by 14:00 PT. Priya to allocate manual capacity for 3 onboardings by tomorrow 10:00. I'm drafting customer comms; will share shortly."

End pocket journal.
